2	 * Commander.js program factory extracted from src/main.tsx.

4	 * excluding the .action() handler and preAction hook (those
5	 * remain in main.tsx and are cut-E territory).

7	 * Moved from src/main.tsx per V7 Phase 4 cut-B.

17	/**
18	 * Creates help configuration that sorts subcommands and options alphabetically.
19	 * Commander supports compareOptions at runtime but @commander-js/extra-typings
20	 * doesn't include it in the type definitions, so we use Object.assign to add it.
21	 */
22	export function createSortedHelpConfig(): {
23	  sortSubcommands: true
24	  sortOptions: true
25	} {
26	  const getOptionSortKey = (opt: Option): string =>
27	    opt.long?.replace(/^--/, '') ?? opt.short?.replace(/^-/, '') ?? ''
28	  return Object.assign({ sortSubcommands: true, sortOptions: true } as const, {
29	    compareOptions: (a: Option, b: Option) =>
30	      getOptionSortKey(a).localeCompare(getOptionSortKey(b)),
31	  })
32	}
33	
34	/**
35	 * Creates and configures the main Commander program with all CLI options.
36	 * Returns the program without .action() or preAction hook attached —
37	 * those are wired in main.tsx's run() function.
38	 */
39	export function createMainProgram(): CommanderCommand {
40	  return new CommanderCommand()
41	    .configureHelp(createSortedHelpConfig())

53	      'Enable debug mode with optional category filtering (e.g., "api,hooks" or "!1p,!file")',

55	        // If value is provided, it will be the filter string
56	        // If not provided but flag is present, value will be true
57	        // The actual filtering is handled in debug.ts by parsing process.argv
58	        return true
59	      },
60	    )
61	    .addOption(
62	      new Option('--debug-to-stderr', 'Enable debug mode (to stderr)')
63	        .argParser(Boolean)
64	        .hideHelp(),
65	    )
66	    .option(
67	      '--debug-file <path>',

Anthropic auth is strictly ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or apiKeyHelper via --settings (OAuth and keychain are never read). 3P providers (Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry) use their own credentials. Skills still resolve via /skill-name. Explicitly provide context via: --system-prompt[-file], --append-system-prompt[-file], --add-dir (CLAUDE.md dirs), --mcp-config, --settings, --agents, --plugin-dir.',
